result.topic_en: Draft notes on the Dirichlet-principle minimizing function ω = u + iv: the vanishing of the variation integral N for every admissible λ (Art. 15), its transformation by integration by parts (Art. 7), the resulting conditions on the derivatives of u and v, and the requirement that the discontinuities of u−α and v−β leave the Dirichlet integrals finite.

methods.what: Vanishing first variation of the Dirichlet-type integral for the minimizing function
methods.quote: $N = \int\left(\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial \beta}{\partial y}\right)\frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial x}+\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial \beta}{\partial x}\right)\frac{\partial \lambda}{\partial y}\right)dS = 0$

methods.what: Integration by parts (Green's theorem, Art. 7) transforming N into an area integral of the Laplacian and a boundary integral
methods.quote: $= -\int \lambda\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\right)dS - \int\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial \beta}{\partial s}\right)\lambda\, ds$
